statistic: trace pseudo-F with full three-factor residual (df=96)

schemes.restricted_pH: whole strips permuted across pH within phone
schemes.restricted_phone: whole strips permuted across phone within pH
schemes.unrestricted_main: row labels permuted across all rows
schemes.interactions: Freedman-Lane, reduced-model residuals permuted across all rows

multiplicity: Holm within region x scaling over the six terms (restricted scheme)
bootstrap: residual bootstrap conditional on observed strips; PC1 sign-aligned to observed
limitations: One strip per phone x pH cell: pH x phone is tested against within-strip residual variation, not against strip-to-strip variation.
The residual combines the three-way interaction with measurement error.
Bootstrap intervals ignore strip sampling variability.
